=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/editor_isolated_run.sh:cleanup case, approximately line 65
  PROBLEM: The `cleanup` action runs `reap "${root}"` before `rm -rf -- "${root}"`. With `set -euo pipefail` enabled, a reap failure (Docker daemon hung, label match failure, or `docker rm` error) aborts the script before `rm -rf` runs, leaving the isolation-root directory orphaned on disk with the snapshot inside.
  WHY: The LAST RUN DIFF explicitly strengthens cleanup to run after a restore failure, but if reap itself keeps failing on the second call inside cleanup, the cleanup still aborts.
  Suggested minimal fix: change the reap call inside the `cleanup)` arm to `reap "${root}" || true` so `rm -rf -- "${root}"` always runs after a successful `valid_root` check. Estimated lines changed: 1
